title: What Is a Server?
summary: A server is a computer that provides information or services to other devices.
objectives: Define a server in your own words.
Describe how servers can store, process, and provide information.

vocab.def: A computer that provides information or services to other computers or devices.
To work with information so a computer can produce a result.

sections.heading: A computer with a job
sections.body: A server is a computer. Its job is to provide information or a service to other computers and devices. A server might help deliver a webpage, save a file, or process a request.

sections.heading: Many servers together
sections.body: A data center contains many servers. They work with networks, power, cooling, and security systems. Servers may share work so a service can respond to many people.

sections.heading: A simple request
sections.body: When a device asks for information, a server receives the request, works with data, and sends back a response. The server does not replace the network or the device; the systems cooperate.

practice.prompt: Match each job to a server: save a photo, send a webpage, or process a request. Explain one match.

quiz.question: What is a server?
options: A computer that provides information or services
A person who works at a store
quiz.answer: A computer that provides information or services

reflectionPrompt: If a server had a job title, what service would you want it to provide?
